messages:
alex.p: Heads-up: we're cutting over CI auth to the Identity Gateway (idp-proxy) next Sat 00:00-02:00 UTC. This will centralize machine identity for runners and remove direct Okta app tokens from repo secrets. Planning doc: https://docs.internal/idp-proxy/ci-cutover (read-before-weekend)

mira.s: Nice — can you call out immediate impacts? who needs to test before the window? :eyes:

alex.p: Short list:
- Github Actions runners will authenticate via idp-proxy service principals instead of per-repo secrets
- Any hardcoded PATs in workflows must be rotated/removed
- Service-account mapping: repo -> infra-sa@redwood (see mapping table in doc)

Please test by Friday: run a full pipeline using `CI_IDP_TEST=true` in a forked repo.

robin.devex: Quick question: how does this affect self-hosted runners? we still need node-level creds?

alex.p: Self-hosted runners will call idp-proxy for a short-lived token; you no longer need to store org-level PATs on runners. Runners will need the proxy agent 0.9.2+ (link in doc). If you maintain runners, plan to upgrade before cutover.

oliver.sre: Rollback plan?

alex.p: If anything breaks, we'll flip traffic to the old Okta passthrough for 30m while we patch. Steps:
1) infra team re-enable okta-proxy route
2) blocklist new tokens
3) revert runner agent to v0.8.x if needed
Rollback runbook in doc with exact commands.

jen.k: Are there any permissions/GitHub RBAC changes? repo admins need awareness.

mira.s: Yep — we introduce an org-level "ci-runner" role. Mapped service accounts will have that permission; repo admins will see new role invite emails. No automatic perms escalation.

robin.devex: I'll ping the repo-owners list and add a small checklist for migrations. Can we get a test org to try the flow?

alex.p: Test org is `redwood-ci-staging`. CI team has pre-created test service accounts. Use `run-e2e.sh --staging` and report failures in this thread.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: idp-proxy CI cutover starting 2026-03-28 00:00 UTC. Expected downtime window: 2 hours. Subscribe for updates: #incidents

ci-deploy-bot: Canary deploys will start at -01:00 UTC. 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% if no errors in 15m checks.

oliver.sre: Any monitoring dashboards to watch? latency / auth error spikes?

alex.p: Watch `ci.auth.errors`, `runners.registration.latency`, and `github.workflow.fail_rate` in Grafana dashboard "CI -> Auth". Alerts preconfigured: Pager for P1, slack for P2.

mira.s: Team action items:
- Dev teams: test by Friday, remove hardcoded PATs
- Runners owners: upgrade agent to 0.9.2
- Repo admins: watch invite emails
- Security: review service-account mappings
I'll run a final readiness check Friday 16:00 UTC.

jen.k: Thx. I'll add a note to the weekly all-hands brief.

alex.p: Thanks all. Post any blockers in this thread; tagging @mira.s and @oliver.sre for readiness checks. :thumbsup:
